report.clinical_summary: Living with early-stage CLL for about a year, detected during routine blood test and monitored every three months. Started first CLL-related medication a few weeks ago, which is causing morning headaches lasting all day and increased fatigue after work. Takes extra painkillers for headaches. Reports feeling overwhelmed, with illness affecting ability to get out of bed, work, and spend quality time with children. Wants to understand CLL progression and treatment options, and feels he should be more involved in decision-making rather than just reacting. Has strong support from wife and friends but has been hesitant to bring up concerns with hematologist due to not wanting to seem ungrateful or add to their workload.

everything is a struggle these days
harder to spend quality time with my kids or do the things I used to enjoy

consequences.reasoning: The patient describes being unable to get out of bed, having the disease take over work and family time, and everything being a struggle. This shows significant impact on daily functioning and major roles.
